// CASE ts_dup_quotes_before_0 expect=fire
export async function run<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      merge(await operation(items[index]), await operation(items[index]));
    }
  }));
}
